review.verdict: Parse 30 against a usual 63
review.summary: 11th to 24th on every boss, average 30 against your usual 63. No boss deaths, two on trash.

review.verdict: Second healer on Noth and Loatheb
review.summary: Second of the healers on Noth and Loatheb, third on Anub'Rekhan. 29 dispels, 9 of them Thunderclap. No deaths.

review.verdict: First healer on eight bosses, no deaths, and the MVP, unfortunately
review.summary: First of the healers on Anub'Rekhan, Faerlina, Thaddius, Gothik, the Horsemen (122k), Noth, Heigan and Kel'Thuzad (121k). No deaths all night, not even on trash, and no Dark Rune incidents. It had to happen eventually. The bar tab hasn't changed: Gordok Green Grog and Kreeg's Stout Beatdown on 14 of 15 pulls, Spirit of Zanza on 1, and 24 Mana Potions to make up for it.

good.title: Healing
good.text: First of the healers on eight bosses.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: Spirit of Zanza on 1 of 15 pulls. The drinks were on 14.

review.verdict: Main tank on eight bosses, parse 95 on Gluth
review.summary: First of the tanks on Maexxna, Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Gluth (parse 95), Heigan, Loatheb, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad. No boss deaths, one trash death to an Infectious Skitterer.

good.title: Tanking
good.text: First of the tanks on eight bosses.

review.verdict: First on Patchwerk, Grobbulus and the Horsemen, first death on Razuvious
review.summary: The most damage on Patchwerk, Grobbulus and the Horsemen (parse 91), third on Gothik, parse 93 on Thaddius. 46 dispels and 5 interrupts. Razuvious' Unbalancing Strike killed you at 0:16, and two trash deaths.

review.verdict: First on Anub'Rekhan, three boss deaths
review.summary: First on Anub'Rekhan, second on Faerlina, Maexxna, Patchwerk and Thaddius, third on Gluth, and tanked the Horsemen. Then the deaths: Razuvious at 0:52, a Spectral Horse on the Gothik wipe, Zeliek's Mark at 2:56 on the Horsemen, and two on trash.

good.title: Damage
good.text: Top three on six of the first seven bosses.

fix.title: Deaths
fix.text: Three boss deaths and two on trash.

review.verdict: In for Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad
review.summary: Fourth on Sapphiron with 7 Life Drains removed, fifth on Kel'Thuzad. No deaths.

review.verdict: 11 Shadow Bolt Volleys kicked
review.summary: 11 interrupts, all Shadow Bolt Volleys. Fourth on Maexxna and Noth, top ten on fourteen bosses. A Frostbolt volley killed you on Kel'Thuzad at 1:51.

review.verdict: Top three on six bosses, no deaths
review.summary: Second on Sapphiron, third on Faerlina, Maexxna, Grobbulus, Noth and Heigan. No boss deaths. Three poison cloud hits on Grobbulus.

review.verdict: Rebirth on Kel'Thuzad, 57 dispels
review.summary: Rebirth on Fluffycatto on Kel'Thuzad, where you were third on healing. 57 dispels (41 Veil of Shadow), 5 curses on Noth, 10 Life Drains. Second of the healers on Grobbulus. Last on Noth.

review.verdict: First on Faerlina and Razuvious
review.summary: First on Faerlina and Razuvious, second on Heigan, third on Patchwerk and Loatheb. Frost Blast killed you on Kel'Thuzad at 1:16.

review.verdict: Tanked six bosses, no deaths
review.summary: Tanked Anub'Rekhan, Grobbulus, Razuvious, Gothik, the Horsemen and Noth. No deaths. Low damage on the rest.

review.verdict: Nine interrupts, first death on Kel'Thuzad
review.summary: Nine interrupts, six of them Frostbolts. Frost Blast killed you at 0:38 on Kel'Thuzad, the first death, and Etowa brought you back. Last on Gluth, 27th on Maexxna. Average 40 against your usual 71.

review.verdict: First healer on Gluth, two boss deaths
review.summary: First of the healers on Gluth. 10 Decrepit Fevers cured on Heigan. Frost Breath killed you on Sapphiron at 2:46, and you died again on Kel'Thuzad at 3:14. Last on Loatheb.

review.verdict: Parse 39 against a usual 74, two boss deaths
review.summary: Fourth on Thaddius, fifth on Anub'Rekhan. Razuvious killed you at 0:59 and a Spectral Horse on the Gothik wipe, and the Acolyte volley on trash. Average 39 against your usual 74.

review.verdict: Two boss deaths, two trash deaths
review.summary: Chill killed you on Sapphiron at 1:53 and a Frostbolt volley on Kel'Thuzad at 1:51. Two trash deaths. Damage 11th to 27th, average 39.

review.verdict: Two boss deaths, four trash deaths
review.summary: Frost Aura killed you on Sapphiron at 1:43 and Frost Blast on Kel'Thuzad at 1:15. Four trash deaths. Last on the Horsemen, 25th on Patchwerk, average 28 against your usual 72.

fix.title: Deaths
fix.text: Two boss deaths, four on trash.

review.verdict: First on Gothik and Loatheb, three wrong-side hits on Thaddius
review.summary: The most damage on Gothik and Loatheb (491k), third on the Horsemen and Sapphiron, parse 88 on Patchwerk and the Horsemen. 23 dispels. Half of the raid's six wrong-side polarity hits on Thaddius were yours, and no damage logged on Faerlina.

fix.title: Thaddius
fix.text: 3 wrong-side hits, half the raid's total.

review.verdict: 42 Hateful Strikes, Thaddius tanked to a 93
review.summary: Soaked 42 of Patchwerk's 60 Hateful Strikes. First of the tanks on Anub'Rekhan, Thaddius (parse 93), Gothik and Noth, and tanked Faerlina, Razuvious and Kel'Thuzad. No deaths.

review.verdict: Died five seconds into Faerlina, four trash deaths
review.summary: A Follower killed you five seconds into Faerlina. Tanked Gluth and the Horsemen. Four trash deaths, last on Heigan, average 24.

review.verdict: Second healer on Patchwerk
review.summary: Second of the healers on Patchwerk (96k), third on Heigan. Frost Blast killed you near the end of Kel'Thuzad.

review.verdict: First healer on Loatheb, held Razuvious alone for 24 seconds
review.summary: First of the healers on Loatheb, second on Maexxna, Gluth and Kel'Thuzad. On Razuvious your control ran from 0:18 to 0:48, the only one holding after 0:24, and nobody had one again until 0:58. A trash death in the Acolyte volley.

review.verdict: 69 dispels, the most
review.summary: 69 dispels: 39 Veil of Shadow, 5 poisons on Faerlina, 7 curses on Noth, the Necrotic Poison on Maexxna, 6 Life Drains. No deaths. Healing last on six bosses, and three Void Zone hits on the Horsemen.

review.verdict: First on four bosses, killed by Thaddius again
review.summary: The most damage on Maexxna, Gluth, Thaddius and Heigan, and 51 dispels. Thaddius' melee killed you at 1:43 for the second Wednesday running, again with the shared Ignite credited to you. Died on the Gothik wipe too. Last on Noth, 26th on Patchwerk.

fix.title: Thaddius
fix.text: Killed by his melee at 1:43, second week running.

review.verdict: Parse 30, three trash deaths
review.summary: Average 30 against your usual 59. A Spectral Horse killed you on the Gothik wipe, and three trash deaths. Three poison cloud hits on Grobbulus.

review.verdict: Three Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth, parse 93 on the Horsemen
review.summary: The other half of Gluth's Frenzies. Parse 93 on the Horsemen (seventh), 86 on Heigan, 85 on Maexxna. Average 76. One wrong-side polarity hit.

review.verdict: 15 interrupts, the most
review.summary: 15 interrupts, the most in the raid, seven of them Kel'Thuzad's Frostbolts. Second on Anub'Rekhan (parse 89) and Kel'Thuzad. Razuvious killed you at 0:54 in the gap with no Understudy holding him, and two trash deaths.

review.verdict: Third healer on Patchwerk, Icebolt on Sapphiron
review.summary: Third of the healers on Patchwerk, fourth on Loatheb. Icebolt killed you on Sapphiron at 2:39. Last on Heigan and Sapphiron.

review.verdict: Second on Gothik, four trash deaths
review.summary: Second on Gothik (parse 81), fourth on Razuvious, sixth on Anub'Rekhan and Sapphiron. Four trash deaths, five poison cloud hits on Grobbulus (the most), and Frost Blast on Kel'Thuzad at 1:47.

review.verdict: Tanked the Horsemen, first tank death on Kel'Thuzad
review.summary: First of the tanks on Faerlina (parse 84) and the Horsemen (77), 16 Hateful Strikes on Patchwerk. Kel'Thuzad's melee killed you at 0:47.

review.verdict: 107k on Patchwerk, all six Injections dispelled
review.summary: First of the healers on Patchwerk (107k), second on Faerlina, third on Gothik. 46 dispels, including all 6 Mutating Injections on Grobbulus and the Necrotic Poison on Maexxna. Last on Grobbulus and Gluth.

review.verdict: Average parse 81, 92 on Heigan
review.summary: Parse 92 on Heigan, 89 on Grobbulus and Gluth, 88 on Patchwerk, 82 on Kel'Thuzad and Sapphiron. Average 81 against your usual 67. Kel'Thuzad's melee killed you at 3:08.

review.verdict: Parse 65 against a usual 45
review.summary: Parse 85 on Patchwerk, Thaddius and Heigan, 82 on Gluth. Average 65. By place last on Anub'Rekhan, Maexxna, Loatheb and Sapphiron. No deaths.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: Last on four bosses by place.

review.verdict: Three Tranquilizing Shots on Gluth, parse 77 average
review.summary: Half of Gluth's six Frenzies were yours. Parse 85 on Noth, 84 on Patchwerk, 83 on Faerlina, Maexxna and Gluth. Average 77. One wrong-side polarity hit.

review.verdict: First on Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad, killed by Anub'Rekhan
review.summary: The most damage on Sapphiron (158k) and Kel'Thuzad (187k), fifth on Loatheb. Anub'Rekhan's melee killed you at 0:19 and Razuvious' at 0:50, plus two trash deaths. Average 38 against your usual 56.

review.verdict: Second on Razuvious, died to Poison on Grobbulus
review.summary: Second on Razuvious, third on Anub'Rekhan, tanked the Horsemen. Five interrupts. Poison killed you on Grobbulus at 0:37, and the Acolyte volley got you on trash. Average 39 against your usual 67.

review.verdict: Bottom of the damage, two trash deaths
review.summary: 26th on Grobbulus, Gluth and Heigan, 24th on Noth and Patchwerk. Two trash deaths. Not in the log for Sapphiron or Kel'Thuzad.

review.verdict: First on Noth, parse 94 on Thaddius
review.summary: The most damage on Noth (131k), fourth on Gothik and Kel'Thuzad, parse 94 on Thaddius and 90 on Maexxna. 43 dispels, 6 curses on Noth, 9 Life Drains. Average 56 against your usual 44. Killed in the Acolyte volley.

review.verdict: Second on five bosses
review.summary: Second on Grobbulus, Gluth, the Horsemen (parse 82), Noth and Loatheb, third on Thaddius, Razuvious and Kel'Thuzad. Frost Breath killed you on Sapphiron at 2:46. Last on Gothik. Average 49 against your usual 79.

review.verdict: First healer on Maexxna and Grobbulus
review.summary: First of the healers on Maexxna and Grobbulus, second on Anub'Rekhan, Gothik, the Horsemen, Heigan and Sapphiron. On Kel'Thuzad a mind-controlled raider's Fireball killed you at 0:45.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: Killed at 0:45 by a mind-controlled raider.

review.verdict: 206k on Sapphiron, and the control that broke on Razuvious
review.summary: First of the healers on Sapphiron (206k), second on Thaddius, 5 Worshippers controlled on Faerlina. On Razuvious your control broke at 0:24, three seconds after you took it, and casts at 0:33, 0:36 and 0:39 didn't land; you had one again at 0:58. Four people died to his melee in between.

fix.title: Razuvious
fix.text: Control broke at 0:24, three recasts failed, back at 0:58.
